```sql
WITH order_values AS (
    SELECT 
        o.id AS order_id,
        SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS order_value
    FROM 
        orders o
    JOIN 
        order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
    JOIN 
        products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
    GROUP BY 
        o.id
),
average_order_value AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(order_value) AS avg_value
    FROM 
        order_values
)
SELECT 
    order_id
FROM 
    order_values
WHERE 
    order_value > (SELECT avg_value FROM average_order_value);
```
